theme.title: Sleighbound
theme.subtitle: The Night Before
theme.premise: It’s Christmas Eve. Grumbleweed, the Winter Troll, snatched the Star from the top of the great tree, and without it the sleigh can’t find its way. His Grumplings scattered the night’s presents across the snow. Recover the presents and bring back the Star before Midnight!

roles.name: Reindeer Flyer
roles.blurb: Fast hooves, faster wings. Loves a running start.

knack.name: Fly
knack.text: Fly up to 8 big steps over anything. A friend next to you who is Knocked Out comes along.

roles.name: Snow Sprite
roles.blurb: A tiny swirl of frost with a big imagination.

knack.name: Freeze
knack.text: Freeze a foe for a little while — or turn water (and cracks) into solid ice.

roles.name: Gingerbread Scout
roles.blurb: Crunchy, quick and never, ever lost.

knack.name: Crumb Trail
knack.text: Jump back to any spot you visited this scene.

roles.name: Toy Soldier
roles.blurb: Wind-up key, steady march, brave heart.

knack.name: Stand Guard
knack.text: Friends next to you can’t lose Hearts for a little while.

roles.name: Carol Singer
roles.blurb: One song and everyone feels warmer.

knack.name: Sing
knack.text: Every friend within 3 big steps gets 1 Heart back.

roles.name: Polar Bear Baker
roles.blurb: Big paws, warm ovens, endless cookies.

knack.name: Cookie Break
knack.text: Hand 2 Cookies to any hero (even yourself).

roles.name: Star Keeper
roles.blurb: Keeps a little starlight in a pocket, just in case.

knack.name: Shine
knack.text: Reveal hidden things within 4 big steps; foes within 4 lose 1 Heart.

items.name: Cookie
items.text: Get 1 Heart back — or give it to a friend next to you.

items.name: Snowball
items.text: Throw it at a foe up to 4 big steps away. On 6 or more they lose 1 Heart.

items.name: Candy Cane Hook
items.text: Pull a friend, a foe or a present 3 big steps toward you.

items.name: Jingle Bell
items.text: Everyone can dash 2 extra big steps for a little while.

items.name: Mystery Present
items.text: Unwrap it: look at 2 items and keep one.

items.name: Sled
items.text: Zoom up to 10 big steps in a straight line.

items.name: Harness Bell
items.text: Jingle-jangle! Move 3 more big steps right now.

items.name: Snowflake Charm
items.text: Freeze a foe up to 3 big steps away for a little while.

items.name: Gumdrop
items.text: Chewy! You or a friend next to you gets 1 Heart back.

items.name: Drum
items.text: Rat-a-tat! Everyone marches 1 extra big step for a little while.

items.name: Lantern
items.text: Shine it around: reveal hidden things within 3 big steps.

foes.name: Grumpling
foes.blurb: Grabs presents and runs off with them.
foes.hint: Grabs the nearest present and runs away from the heroes (about 4 m). Knock it out to get the present back.

foes.name: Coal Imp
foes.blurb: Throws lumps of coal from 3 big steps away.
foes.hint: Throws coal at a hero within 3 m: −1 Heart. Likes to stay by its chimney and guard the present.

foes.name: Wind-up Rat
foes.blurb: Zips around in packs of three. Bumps into everything.
foes.hint: Zips up to 6 m and bumps into a hero: −1 Heart. The rats always move together.

foes.name: Blizzard Wisp
foes.blurb: A puff of storm that blows heroes 2 big steps away.
foes.hint: Floats up to 3 m and blows a hero next to it 2 m away — drag the hero to show the gust.

foes.name: Snow Golem
foes.blurb: Huge, slow, and very good at standing in the way.
foes.hint: Slow (2 m at a time). Plants itself in the narrow spot so nobody can get past.

foes.name: Grumbleweed
foes.blurb: The Winter Troll. Big, mean and cold. He stole the Star.

phases.name: Snowball Storm
phases.text: Grumbleweed scoops up snow and throws big snowballs!
phases.hint: Throws a big snowball at a hero within 4 m: −1 Heart. Then stomps 2 m closer.

phases.name: Grumpling Call
phases.text: Grumbleweed whistles — Grumplings come running to help him!
phases.hint: Whistles for help: spawn a Grumpling next to him (up to 2 at a time), or throw a snowball.

phases.name: The Big Sulk
phases.text: Grumbleweed hides behind a wall of ice. Break through and finish him!
phases.hint: Hides behind a wall of ice. Heroes have to get past the wall (or throw things over it) to hit him.

foes.hint: Big and slow (2 m). Hits hard.

events.name: Gust
events.text: Everyone slides 1 big step in the wind’s direction.

events.name: Grumpling Ambush
events.text: Two Grumplings pop up at the edge of the map!

events.name: Northern Lights
events.text: The sky glows green and pink. +1 Twinkle!

events.name: Cocoa Stand
events.text: Someone left a Hot Cocoa out for you!

events.name: Bells in the Distance
events.text: Ding, dong… Midnight creeps 1 step closer.

events.name: Snow Angel
events.text: The next hero who gets Knocked Out pops right back up.

adventures.name: The Night Before
adventures.blurb: Four short scenes from the Toy Workshop to the Troll’s Ice Cave.

scenes.name: Workshop Chaos
scenes.intro: The Toy Workshop is where every toy in the world is built — but tonight three Wind-up Rats are zooming between the workbenches! Two presents are lost in the mess. Find them, and find out where the Troll went.
scenes.win: Both presents are safe! Dapple points the way: across the Frozen Lake.

props.story: The big workshop door. Big, heavy Troll footprints lead out into the snow…
Half-built toys everywhere — and tiny wind-up footprints in the sawdust!
A wobbly mountain of toys. Is something hiding in there?
Teddy bears and tin drums — nothing hidden here.
The sleigh is packed and ready — but it can’t find its way without the Star.

tokens.label: a present buried in the toy pile
Dapple the Rocking Horse
tokens.text: Neigh! The big Troll stomped off toward the Frozen Lake with the Star — and one present is hiding in the toy pile!

scenes.name: Frozen Lake
scenes.intro: The lake is frozen, shiny and very slippery — walk onto the ice and you slide a little further than you meant to! The ice is cracking in two long lines. Test the ice carefully: 4 steady tries before it wobbles 3 times. One present sits on the little island.
scenes.win: The cracks freeze solid behind you and everyone slides safely to the far shore. Wheee!
scenes.lose: The ice is too wobbly! Everyone takes the long, chilly way round — the night is getting late.

props.story: A little stand with a sign: “Free cocoa for brave lake-crossers!”

goal.text: Test the ice: 4 steady tries before 3 wobbles. Grab the island present if you can!

scenes.name: Rooftop Run
scenes.intro: Over the Gingerbread Village roofs! Coal Imps sit by the chimneys, guarding two presents — and a Grumpling is sneaking about. Some gaps are too wide to walk across: fly, leap, or find the narrow ridge.
scenes.win: Both presents are back! From the top of the roofs you can see a glow coming from an ice cave…

props.story: Warm air puffs out. You can hear someone snoring inside!
Sooty and warm. A Coal Imp has been sitting here — there are little black handprints.
Someone inside is baking gingerbread. It smells wonderful.

goal.text: Get the 2 presents the Coal Imps are guarding.

scenes.name: The Ice Cave
scenes.intro: Deep in the Ice Cave sits Grumbleweed the Winter Troll, clutching the Star. A Snow Golem stands in the way. Knock him out and take the Star back! A present is hidden somewhere in here too.
scenes.win: The Star is back in your hands, glowing warm and bright. Time to fly!

props.story: A big icy boulder. There are scrape marks behind it…
The way you came in. Cold wind whistles through the arch.

goal.text: Knock out Grumbleweed and take back the Star.

endings.text: The Star blazes on the tree, the sleigh is packed with presents, and off it flies. Almost every home gets its gifts by morning! The best Christmas Eve ever.
With the Star back on the tree, the sleigh finds its way. Not every present made it, but lots of homes wake up to a happy surprise.
The Star is home and the sleigh flies! It’s a light load this year — so everyone writes extra-cheerful cards to go with the few presents.
Midnight comes before the Star does, but the moon shines extra bright tonight. The sleigh follows it, slowly and carefully, with the presents you saved.
Midnight arrives and the sleigh stays home this year. Everyone shares hot cocoa by the fire and plans an even better adventure for next Christmas Eve.

tableMoments.name: Wrap it!
tableMoments.text: The performer acts out the secret gift without words. First to guess it wins a Twinkle for the team!

tableMoments.name: Draw the Ornament
tableMoments.text: The performer has 30 seconds to draw the secret ornament. Everyone votes for who guessed it first!

tableMoments.name: Hum-a-tune
tableMoments.text: The performer hums the secret song — no words allowed! First to name it wins a Twinkle.
prompts: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
Angels We Have Heard on High
